notes: Verifier I, wave 4 (batch I, I05). Printed: 'Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 3 or less.' Targets are priced together with the cast: with only a mana value 4 creature and a mana value 6 planeswalker on the battlefield no choice of target is legal, so the menu offers no Eliminate row at all (the window asks nothing and passes; the word 'cast:card:0' is never taken).
